# V1 diagnostics, flow inspection, and recovery

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-v1-guides.ts from verified canonical output. Do not edit this output by hand. -->

The public `fadeno check` command reports framework semantics in human form.
The analyzer that owns its facts remains private and tool-neutral; the machine
records shown here are verified repository evidence, not a stable external
schema or supported editor protocol.

## Successful check

Run `fadeno check --project-root .` from an installed canonical application.
Success reports the accepted workspace epoch, route count, and planned artifact
count without writing `.fadeno` or `dist`.

```text
Fadeno framework route analysis completed: 10 routes, 7 artifacts planned, no files written.
```

## Deliberate route-role collision

The isolated failure fixture declares incompatible owners for one route. The
human diagnostic identifies the stable code, exact primary location, related
owner, cause, and safe correction intent. `check` exits unsuccessfully and
does not publish a mixed artifact generation.

```text
FADENO_ROUTE_ROUTE_ROLE_OWNER: Handler ownership conflicts at route /.
  at src/routes/handler.ts (range unavailable: filesystem-entry)
  related src/routes/page.tsx (range unavailable: filesystem-entry)
  correction: FADENO_FIX_REVIEW_ROUTE_ROLE_COLLISION (review)
  explanation: https://fadeno.dev/diagnostics/routes/route-role-collision
FADENO_ROUTE_ROUTE_ROLE_OWNER: Page ownership conflicts at route /.
  at src/routes/page.tsx (range unavailable: filesystem-entry)
  related src/routes/handler.ts (range unavailable: filesystem-entry)
  correction: FADENO_FIX_REVIEW_ROUTE_ROLE_COLLISION (review)
  explanation: https://fadeno.dev/diagnostics/routes/route-role-collision
FADENO_ROUTE_ROUTE_ROLE_COLLISION: Route / has conflicting owners.
  at src/routes/handler.ts (range unavailable: filesystem-entry)
  related src/routes/page.tsx (range unavailable: filesystem-entry)
  caused by: FADENO_ROUTE_ROUTE_ROLE_OWNER, FADENO_ROUTE_ROUTE_ROLE_OWNER
  correction: FADENO_FIX_REVIEW_ROUTE_ROLE_COLLISION (review)
  explanation: https://fadeno.dev/diagnostics/routes/route-role-collision
SKIPPED manifest-publication: FADENO_ROUTE_ROUTE_ROLE_COLLISION
```

```json
}
```

## Correction intent

Corrections are analyzer-owned structured intents; consumers do not infer them
from diagnostic prose. This verified example removes an unsafe selective
revalidation hint and falls back to complete correctness-first revalidation.

Before:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "scenario": "resource-keeps-correction",
  "keeps": [
    "tasks",
    "permissions",
    "stable",
    "activity",
    "flaky",
    "not-active"
  ],
  "decisions": [
    "unsafe",
    "unsafe",
    "verified",
    "unsafe",
    "unsafe",
    "not-active"
  ],
  "complete": false,
  "correctnessReads": 5
}
```

After:

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "scenario": "resource-keeps-correction",
  "keeps": [
    "stable"
  ],
  "decisions": [
    "verified"
  ],
  "complete": true,
  "correctnessReads": 4,
  "correctnessReadsRemovedByOptimization": 0
}
```

## Repair and stale removal

After repairing the route collision, the next complete publication replaces
the diagnostic batch and removes stale generated ownership. The old error is
not retained beside the repaired state.

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": 1,
  "scenario": "route-role-collision",
  "correction": "remove-the-conflicting-handler",
  "staleDiagnosticRemoved": true,
  "staleArtifactsRemoved": true,
  "publishedRouteIds": [
    "/"
  ]
}
```

Run `pnpm check:v1-analyzer-workflow` for the packed check/recovery path and
`pnpm check:v1-running-example` for build, runtime, resource, action, rollback,
and stale-output recovery.
